text:
maya-partners: Kicking off a quick sync for the marketplace listing onboarding pilot (AWS/GCP/Azure). Main goals: canonical SKU + bundle packaging, private-offer activation flow, and a minimal ops runbook for staging. Meeting in 30.

priyanka-product: I'll own the package defs. Need a format that includes entitlement IDs, trial_days, and whether SLA metrics are included. Suggest CSV with: product_code,package_id,entitlement_ids(triplepipe),trial_days,slas_included. Example: 
```
product_code,package_id,entitlement_ids,trial_days,slas_included
red-core,red-core-2024,ENT-CORE-1|||ENT-CORE-2,14,true
embed-lite,embed-lite-std,ENT-EMB-1,0,false
```
Can ops confirm what package_id should look like on each cloud?

sam-devops: Ops checklist coming. For cloud-specific fields we need: cloud_account_number,private_offer_enabled,true/false,kms_alias,region_ami_map_url,marketplace_role_arn. Also note: GCP private offers require a billing project id; AWS needs SellerPrivateOffer activation role. I'll publish a Google Sheet with account numbers and roles.

liam-legal: Quick legal Qs: (1) telemetry retention for billing payloads (we currently default 90 days) — marketplace teams usually want 30. Any security constraints? (2) reseller/SI pricing needs a separate addendum. We can provide a one-paragraph addendum for this pilot. I'll attach a short SR template to the ticket.

nina-cloud: On region/AMI: some Azure regions still lack gpu VM SKUs we use. We should include a fallback SKU per region and a clear note in the listing. Also: container image URI must live in our parity registry (registry.redwood/marketplace). Ops: can you add image tags and manifest digest in the ops sheet?

priyanka-product: Good catch. I'll add fallback_package_id column to the CSV + container_image and manifest_digest columns.

sam-devops: Telemetry sample payload for billing (protobuf-friendly) — posting simple JSON for initial contract: 
```json
{
  "acct": "acct:0x9f3",
  "offer": "red-core-2024",
  "cloud": "azure",
  "region": "eastus2",
  "units_consumed": 120.5,
  "unit_type": "tokens",
  "event_ts": "2024-05-07T14:23:00Z"
}
```
Ensure "units_consumed" and "unit_type" are in the contract. We also need an accept-endpoint and HMAC header for auth.

liam-legal: For retention, Security prefers 90 days for raw telemetry but billing can summarize to 30 days. I'll put a clause: raw meter events retained 90d, aggregated billing records retained 365d. Sound ok?

maya-partners: That split is fine. For the partner-facing docs we need: eligibility criteria (si_eligible), private_offer_flow(link to how-to), and contact for enablement. Priyanka include a column `enablement_contact` with email handle.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-2045: marketplace-onboard-pilot. Assignees: @maya-partners @priyanka-product @sam-devops @liam-legal @nina-cloud. Link: https://jira.redwood/MP-2045

priyanka-product: Action items from this thread: 1) Publish full CSV with package_id, fallback_package_id,container_image,manifest_digest,entitlement_ids,trial_days,slas_included,enablement_contact by EOD. 2) Add pricing_override column for private-offer price.

sam-devops: My actions: publish ops sheet with account numbers + role ARNs + kms aliases + egress rules, and provide a curl example for the ingest endpoint (test token) by tomorrow morning.

liam-legal: I'll upload SR addendum + telemetry clause draft into MP-2045 by EOD. If SI pricing is involved flag it in CSV and we'll fast-track approval.

nina-cloud: I'll verify region parity and populate fallback SKUs in the ops sheet. Also will run the acceptance checklist in staging and post results.

maya-partners: Great. We'll review the artifacts in the 11:00am PT sync and validate we can enable 3 pilots next week. Thanks everyone.
